title: Exclude the 31-leaf target with a chronological connector rank bound
body:
The proposed **31-leaf caller with five rank-two connectors is impossible under the requested two-port full star contract**. Paired rank-two full queries need total thin rank at least **28**, rather than ten. Even arbitrarily fine nonzero full-stage splits at this dimension need rank at least **20**. **No kappa increase is claimed.**

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9/research/coupled31-chronology/PROOF.md), [complete tariff and obligation ledger](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9/research/coupled31-chronology/COST.md), [exact evidence](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9/research/coupled31-chronology/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9/research/coupled31-chronology/SOURCES.json).

The new theorem applies over every characteristic-two field and every finite dimension. If the core dimension is d, every nonzero full query has rank at least r, and b is the extra thin row dimension, then `g <= (floor(d/r)+1)b+2`. The image-space version is the same. For paired stages this gives `R >= 4q+2 ceil((g-2)/3)`. A prefix determinant contradiction forces a dimension drop on untouched leaves; iteration proves the bound. This uses chronology, beyond the static cut in [PR5673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5673) and its sharp witnesses in [PR5681](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5681). Those static witnesses remain valid. The old 127-leaf ten-rank-one target now needs rank at least 88.

An exact concave tangent proves that **every paired-star profile with one or two coupled ports loses at saving .00256**, for every positive leaf count. All larger savings lose too. The calculation retains the entire pinned PR5599 paid and helper inventory and charges the new thin-rank lower bound. It is a scoped recursive-tariff ceiling, not a general native lower bound.

A [second proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9/research/coupled31-chronology/COMMUTING.md) gives a sharp map-count bound: commuting full projectors need at least `ceil(g/2)` thin maps of any rank. [WORD31.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9/research/coupled31-chronology/WORD31.json) is a complete binary endpoint at that bound: 62 full calls and 16 thin maps of rank eight per two-port block. Every Laurent coefficient is checked without expanding 2^31 stage terms. At 104 ports its 6656 thin rank-one queries give linear margin -3472 and loss at every concave moment. This is a positive operator control with a negative complete recursive price; it is not a native supplier.

Five-map construction targets now need larger coupling and noncommuting full projectors. The 31-leaf, 26-port profile and 13-leaf, eight-port profile pass the new necessary bound and optimistic prices .0035 and .0034. Neither has a supplied word. Two all-order small coupled-seed searches timed out and remain unknown. Native frame maps, physical reads, owned/borrowed state, COPY/CLEAR, dirty compensation, restoration, routes, precision, compiler and outer transfer remain explicit obligations. The characteristic-zero qualifications in [PR5701](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5701) are retained.

```sh
git fetch https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds.git c10f75f09e41803ae8efe478331a7509b7379b2f
git fetch https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds.git 67f07448eec5ad8d84bdf96b46981ac0b893592f
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled31-chronology
```

Expected: `PASS_CHRONOLOGICAL_CONNECTOR_RANK_BOUND` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Normal and optimized replay, five corrupted-package controls, all 25 committed files, export integrity and sealed Git-free replay pass. Checks include 216 exact polynomial prefix updates, 2700 local systems with 104 strict dimension drops, the 128-field endpoint, and 66 complete F4 grid assignments including the retained noncommuting escape word. Finite controls support the written proofs; they are not human or proof-assistant acceptance. Full source-history preflight was not run because the two open predecessor commits are explicit provenance outside the fresh-main ancestry. Original-source and retained-copy bytes are separately pinned. Hosted CI and independent scientific review are pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Canonical main refreshed before submission to `553d26d796fde9871ff2661a49ac7732e945410f`; the changed commits do not alter the entry guidance, priority seven, selected kappa `.00310045`, or consumed P104 tariff. Final head: `f9a3bc99b186b2e08a855e260f2f904ef33821c9`. The complete tariff source is PR5599 at `09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137`. Live overlap was checked; no frontier change, merge or closure occurs. Coordination: [Discussion5593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5593#discussioncomment-19197117).
